
replaceOnce(ui, `    document.querySelectorAll('[data-cart-total]').forEach(element => {
    element.textContent = fmt(pricing.total);
  });`, `    document.querySelectorAll('[data-cart-total]').forEach(element => {
    element.textContent = fmt(pricing.total);
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-price-slot]').forEach(slot => {
    const product = state.productMap.get(String(slot.dataset.priceSlot || ''));
    if (!product) return;
    const display = productDisplay(state, product, pricing);
    slot.innerHTML = `${display.original > display.effective ? `<s>${fmt(display.original)}</s>` : ''}<strong>${fmt(display.effective)}</strong>`;
  });`, 'update price slots');

replaceOnce(ui, `    renderRoute,
  updateShell,`, `    renderRoute,
  loadMoreOffers,
  updateShell,`, 'return loadMoreOffers');

// 5) Remover estado e CSS dos banners dinâmicos.
update('app-next/src/core.js', source => source
  .replace(`    banners: [],\n`, '')
  .replace(`    bannerConfig: {},\n`, ''));
update('app-next/src/catalog.js', source => source.replace(`    banners: [],\n`, ''));
update('app-next/styles/storefront-components.css', source => source.replace(`.banner-zone{margin-bottom:14px}\n.banner-track{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}\n.banner-card{min-width:min(72vw,260px);aspect-ratio:.78;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;scroll-snap-align:start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line)}\n.banner-card img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}\n\n`, ''));

// 6) Remover o renderizador paralelo de ofertas de todos os shells e geradores.
const textFiles = walk('.').filter(file => /\.(?:html|js|mjs|json|css)$/.test(file));
for (const file of textFiles) {
  let source = read(file);
  const original = source;
  source = source
    .replace(/^\s*<link rel="modulepreload" href="\/app-next\/src\/fast-offers-v9\.js\?v=20260727-10">\s*\n/gm, '')
    .replace(/^\s*<script type="module" src="\/app-next\/src\/fast-offers-v9\.js\?v=20260727-10"><\/script>\s*\n/gm, '');
  if (source !== original) write(file, source);
}

]) assert(fastOffers.includes(marker), `Ofertas progressivas incompletas: ${marker}`);
`, `
`, 'remove smoke fast offers');

  .replace(`  'src/fast-offers-v9.js', 'src/bundle-routes.js'`, `  'src/bundle-routes.js'`)

  .replace(`  'app-next/src/fast-offers-v9.js', 'app-next/src/bundle-routes.js',`, `  'app-next/src/bundle-routes.js',`)

for (const file of walk('app-next/src').filter(file => file.endsWith('.js'))) {
